businessModel: Free closed experiment; no paid tier announced
summary: Experimental Google Labs browser announced Dec 11, 2025. GenTabs reads open tabs and chat history to build interactive web apps. macOS waitlist only; ideas may flow into Chrome. Prompt-based interface instead of a URL bar.
bestFor: Early adopters wanting to test Gemini-built tab apps
Researchers planning trips or lessons across tabs
notFor: Users outside the US or under 18

pros.title: GenTabs
pros.detail: Builds interactive apps (meal plans, trip plans) from your tabs and refines them in natural language.

pros.title: Source links
pros.detail: Google says generated elements link back to the original web sources.

pros.title: Google backing
pros.detail: Built with Gemini 3 by Google Labs.

cons.title: Waitlist only
cons.detail: macOS and invite-gated; no public download.

cons.title: Experiment risk
cons.detail: Google Labs projects can end or be folded into Chrome.

cons.title: Data use unclear
cons.detail: Retention and training use of tabs/chat history is not covered in Google's post.

faq.a: Join the waitlist at labs.google/disco; macOS only, starting with a small tester group.
Reports say it is built on Chromium; Google's own post does not say.
Google says the best ideas may reach larger products, likely Chrome.

timeline.event: Disco and GenTabs announced (Dec 11), macOS waitlist
Covered by 9to5Google, Neowin as closed US beta
No newer public release found in sources reviewed

jsSpeed: Blink/V8 engine, Chrome-class JS speed; no vendor benchmark
pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
privacyDefaults: Tabs and chat history feed Gemini; terms unclear
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
patchSpeed: Google ships Chromium fixes fast (unverified for Disco)
telemetry: Vendor telemetry; prompts processed in cloud
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Tab groups and search; no workspaces documented
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
productivity: GenTabs builds task apps from open tabs
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
extras: AI agent and memory; no VPN or wallet
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer
businessTrust: Google data practices, experiment terms unclear
longevity: Labs experiment; may be folded into Chrome

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026

unverified: Whether still waitlist-only in Oct 2026 (newest source about 94 days old)
